summary.text: Andrew Dale is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business consultant, he is principal of Harbinger Coach, LLC, and chairs the Delaware County Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Dale graduated from Burris Laboratory School, earned an associate degree from Vincennes University in 1988 and a bachelor's degree from Ball State University in 1990.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he holds leadership coaching certificates from Harvard University's Continuing Education Division.

Early in his career he served by appointment as director of Community Development for the City of Muncie and as director of Community Affairs and Economic Development for the City of York, Pennsylvania, and he managed and owned his family's business, David Dale Designs, according to the survey.
Dale said he is co-founder and director emeritus of the Shafer Leadership Academy, president of the Muncie Fire Merit Commission, and a board member of the Whitely Community Council.
He named utility costs, childcare and housing as key campaign issues.
